title: Verification gate does not run pyright or ruff format — incomplete quality checks
description: The bootstrap verification gate ran 4 checks (uv sync, import test, ruff check, pytest collect) but omitted pyright type checking and ruff format compliance. Pyright fails with 2 errors (fastapi not resolved in root venv) and 7 files fail ruff format. These issues would have been caught and fixed during the verification-retry cycle if the checks were included.
root_cause: Phase 4.1 (Run Language-Appropriate Verification) lists 'ruff check .' but not 'ruff format --check .' or 'pyright'. The pyright failure reveals a deeper issue: UV workspace members' transitive dependencies are not installed by 'uv sync' on the root package, causing import resolution failures for tools that analyze the full workspace.
recommendation: In Phase 4.1, expand the Python verification commands to include: (1) 'uv run ruff format --check .' for formatting compliance, (2) 'uv run pyright' for type checking. Also add a pre-verification step: 'uv sync --all-packages' to ensure all workspace member dependencies are available for cross-package type checking.
bootstrap_context: Phase 1, Python 3.13 + UV workspace + pyright + ruff
migration_note: Auto-marked applied during bootstrap → bootstrap_converge merge
